name: Flow · 0 Error alerts

parameters.content:
## Benjaire Flow · Error alerts
Set as the error workflow for Flow 1 to 4. When a production run fails, the ops address gets the workflow, failing step, error message and a link to the run. No customer data is included.

description: Benjaire Flow error handler: when any Flow workflow fails, emails the ops address from contact@ with the workflow, step, error and a link to the run.
